words.definition: n. 体积，容积；巨大笨重的身体；大部分（the bulk of）

examples.en: The bulk of the evidence points to the same suspect.
examples.zh: 大部分证据指向同一名嫌疑人。

examples.en: These goods are much cheaper if bought in bulk.
examples.zh: 这些货物批量购买要便宜得多。

words.usage: 高频短语 the bulk of …的大半；in bulk 大批量，buy in bulk 批量囤货；bulk large 显得重要。派生：bulky adj. 笨重的；bulk buying 大宗购买
collocations: the bulk of 大部分
in bulk 大批量
bulk buying 大宗购买
words.mnemonic: 谐音「霸库」→ 霸占仓库大半 → 大部分，大块

words.definition: n. 纽扣；按钮 vt. 扣紧，扣上

examples.en: The top button of his shirt was missing.
examples.zh: 他衬衫最上面的纽扣丢了。

examples.en: She buttoned her coat against the biting wind.
examples.zh: 她扣紧大衣以抵御刺骨寒风。

words.usage: 名词两义纽扣、按钮：press a button 按按钮；习语 on the button 恰好；动词 button up 扣上。派生：buttoned adj. 扣紧的；unbutton v. 解开纽扣

confusables.note: 羊肉；m 与 b 之差

collocations: press a button 按按钮
button up one's coat 扣好大衣
a top button 领口纽扣
words.mnemonic: but+ton（吨）→ 但按一吨重的按钮 → 按钮

words.definition: adj. 哑的，无言的；沉默的；（口）愚蠢的

examples.en: The fever left her dumb for several months.
examples.zh: 那场高烧让她数月不能说话。

examples.en: It was dumb of me to lend him the money.
examples.zh: 我把钱借给他真是太蠢了。

words.usage: 本义哑的、无言的；今多引申「愚蠢的」，口语色彩；短语 play dumb 装傻、dumb down 降低难度。派生：dumbly adv. 沉默地；dumbness n. 沉默

confusables.note: 倾倒，垃圾场；p 与 b
麻木的；n 与 d 之差

collocations: play dumb 装傻
dumb down 降低水准
strike sb dumb 使某人哑然
words.mnemonic: dummy（木偶）变身 → 木偶不说话 → 哑的，沉默的

words.definition: vt. 擦，摩擦；揉搓

examples.en: She rubbed the mirror with a soft cloth to clear the fog.
examples.zh: 她用软布擦拭镜子除去雾气。

examples.en: The cream should be gently rubbed into the skin.
examples.zh: 药膏应被轻轻揉进皮肤。

words.usage: 及物：rub sth with sth 用…擦、rub…into 揉进；习语 rub shoulders with 与名人交往、rub out 擦掉。派生：rubber n. 橡皮，橡胶
collocations: rub one's eyes 揉眼睛
rub shoulders with 与名人交往
rub out 擦掉
words.mnemonic: 谐音「拉布」→ 拉块布来擦 → 擦，摩擦

words.definition: n. 无人机；嗡嗡声；雄蜂 vi. 嗡嗡叫；单调絮叨

examples.en: A drone hovered over the field to monitor crop growth.
examples.zh: 一架无人机在田地上空盘旋监测作物长势。

examples.en: The lecturer droned on and on about tax law.
examples.zh: 讲课的人没完没了地单调念叨税法。

words.usage: 新义高频指无人机 an unmanned drone；本义雄蜂、嗡嗡声 the drone of traffic；动词 drone on 单调絮叨。派生：droning adj. 单调低沉的

confusables.note: 淹死；w 与 n 之差

collocations: a drone strike 无人机空袭
drone on 单调地絮叨
pilot a drone 操纵无人机
words.mnemonic: dr+one：独自嗡嗡飞的家伙 → 无人机；独自念经 → 絮叨

words.definition: n. 礼堂，会堂；（美）观众席，听众席

examples.en: The graduation ceremony will be held in the main auditorium.
examples.zh: 毕业典礼将在大礼堂举行。

examples.en: The auditorium fell silent as the conductor raised his baton.
examples.zh: 指挥举起指挥棒，观众席安静了下来。

words.usage: 可数名词，指礼堂、阶梯讲堂，美式亦指观众席；the packed auditorium 座无虚席。词根 aud 听：联想 audience 听众、audible 听得见的
collocations: a packed auditorium 座无虚席的礼堂
in the auditorium 在礼堂
a school auditorium 学校礼堂
words.mnemonic: audit（听）+orium（场所）→ 听讲之处 → 礼堂

words.definition: n. 全体船员（机组、乘务组）；一队工作人员

examples.en: The crew worked around the clock to unload the cargo.
examples.zh: 船员们昼夜不停地卸货。

examples.en: A film crew arrived to shoot a documentary in the village.
examples.zh: 一支摄制组来村里拍纪录片。

words.usage: 集合名词，视为整体谓语用单数，强调成员行动时可用复数；a crew of ten 十人班组；习语 skeleton crew 基本值守人员。派生：crewman n. 船员
collocations: a film crew 摄制组
a crew member 机组人员
skeleton crew 基本值守人员
words.mnemonic: c+row（划）→ 一排人齐力划船 → 全体船员

words.definition: adj. 残忍的，野蛮的；毫不留情的；严酷的

examples.en: The regime was notorious for its brutal suppression of dissent.
examples.zh: 该政权以残酷镇压异见而臭名昭著。

examples.en: He faced the brutal truth with surprising calm.
examples.zh: 他以惊人的平静面对残酷的事实。

words.usage: 本义残暴的 a brutal attack、brutal repression 残酷镇压；引申直言不讳的 brutal honesty；亦形容严酷 a brutal winter。派生：brutality n. 残暴
collocations: a brutal attack 残忍袭击
brutal honesty 直言不讳
brutal repression 残酷镇压
words.mnemonic: brut（野兽 brute）+al → 野兽般的 → 残忍的

words.definition: adj. 结实的，坚固耐用的；坚定的，顽强的

examples.en: The hikers crossed the stream on a sturdy wooden bridge.
examples.zh: 徒步者们通过一座结实的木桥过溪。

examples.en: The sturdy villagers withstood the flood and rebuilt their homes.
examples.zh: 坚毅的村民们顶住洪水重建了家园。

words.usage: 具体义结实的 sturdy boots、牢固的 a sturdy table；抽象义坚决的 sturdy resistance 顽强抵抗；形容人健壮。派生：sturdily adv. 坚固地
collocations: a sturdy pair of boots 结实的靴子
sturdy resistance 顽强抵抗
a sturdy child 健壮的孩子
words.mnemonic: study（学习）+r → 学习也要身体结实 → 健壮

words.definition: vi. 绊倒，踉跄；偶然发现（upon/across）；说话结巴

examples.en: He stumbled on a loose stone and almost fell.
examples.zh: 他被一块松动的石头绊了一下，差点摔倒。

examples.en: Researchers stumbled upon a rare manuscript in the archive.
examples.zh: 研究人员在档案馆里偶然发现了一份珍稀手稿。

words.usage: 不及物：stumble over sth 被…绊倒；stumble upon/across sth 偶然发现，高频；说话磕绊 stumble over words。习语 stumbling block 绊脚石

confusables.note: 咕哝；st 与 m 之差

collocations: stumble over a stone 被石头绊倒
stumble upon a plan 偶然发现计划
a stumbling block 绊脚石
words.mnemonic: s+tumble（翻滚）→ 先绊倒再翻滚

words.definition: adj. 坦率的，直言不讳的

examples.en: To be frank, the proposal is far from practical.
examples.zh: 坦白说，这份建议书毫不实际。

examples.en: She gave a frank assessment of the team's weaknesses.
examples.zh: 她对该团队的弱点作了坦率评估。

words.usage: 句型 be frank with sb about sth 对某人直言；插入语 to be frank 坦率地说，写作常用。派生：frankly adv. 坦白地；frankness n. 坦诚
collocations: to be frank 坦白说
a frank discussion 坦诚的讨论
be frank with sb 对某人坦率
words.mnemonic: 词源「自由民」→ 自由人才敢说真话 → 坦率

words.definition: vi. 爆炸；爆发，激增 vt. 使爆炸；推翻（观点）

examples.en: The gas cylinder exploded, shattering every window.
examples.zh: 煤气罐爆炸，震碎了所有窗户。

examples.en: Online shopping has exploded in the past decade.
examples.zh: 过去十年网购规模急剧膨胀。

words.usage: 不及物「爆炸、激增」the population exploded；及物「引爆、推翻观点」explode a myth 破除迷思。派生：explosion n. 爆炸，激增；explosive adj. 爆炸性的

confusables.note: 探索；r 与 d 一字之差

collocations: explode a myth 破除迷思
population explosion 人口激增
explode with rage 勃然大怒
words.mnemonic: ex（出）+plode（爆裂）→ 炸裂而出 → 爆炸

words.definition: v. （使）破裂，龟裂；砸开；破解 n. 裂缝；爆裂声；尝试

examples.en: The mirror cracked but did not shatter.
examples.zh: 镜子裂了，但没有碎。

examples.en: The police finally cracked the international fraud ring.
examples.zh: 警方最终破获了这个国际诈骗团伙。

words.usage: 动词「裂而不碎」，区别于 shatter 粉碎；及物引申破解 crack a code 破译密码；习语 crack down on 严打。派生：cracked adj. 有裂缝的

confusables.note: 曲柄，怪念头；a 与 c

collocations: crack down on 严厉打击
crack a code 破译密码
a crack in the wall 墙上裂缝
words.mnemonic: 拟声「咔嚓」→ 裂开之声 → 裂缝，破裂

words.definition: adj. 自由职业的；n. 自由职业者；adv. 以自由职业方式

examples.en: She quit her office job and went freelance as a graphic designer.
examples.zh: 她辞掉办公室工作，做起了自由平面设计师。

examples.en: The rise of remote work has pushed millions into freelance employment.
examples.zh: 远程办公的兴起使数百万人转投自由职业。

words.usage: 作形容词最常见：a freelance journalist 自由撰稿记者。短语 go freelance 转做自由职业，work freelance 以自由职业方式工作。派生：freelancer n. 自由职业者，平台经济类阅读高频词。

confusables.note: 高速公路，词义完全不同

collocations: freelance journalist 自由撰稿记者
go freelance 转做自由职业
freelance work 自由职业工作
words.mnemonic: free（自由）+lance（长矛）→ 自由挥矛的雇佣兵 → 自由职业者

words.definition: vt. 驱逐；开除；排出（气体、液体）

examples.en: Two students were expelled from the university for falsifying research data.
examples.zh: 两名学生因伪造研究数据被大学开除。

examples.en: The lungs expel carbon dioxide with every breath we take.
examples.zh: 我们每次呼吸时，肺部都会排出二氧化碳。

words.usage: 正式用语，指强行逐出：expel sb from school or country 开除学籍、驱逐出境；物作宾语时指排出：expel air from the lungs 呼出肺内气体。派生：expulsion n. 驱逐，开除，常与介词 from 连用。
collocations: expel sb from school 将某人开除学籍
expel a diplomat 驱逐外交官
expel air from the lungs 呼出肺内气体
words.mnemonic: ex（外）+pel（推）→ 向外推出去 → 驱逐，开除

words.definition: vi. 爬行，匍匐前进；（车流）缓慢挪动；n. 缓慢爬行；爬泳

examples.en: The baby crawled across the carpet toward her toys.
examples.zh: 婴儿爬过地毯，朝她的玩具挪去。

examples.en: Traffic crawled along the icy highway for hours after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雪过后，车流在结冰的高速公路上爬行了好几个小时。

words.usage: 本义爬行：The baby crawled across the floor；引申车辆缓慢挪动：Traffic crawled along 车流缓缓蠕动。短语 crawl with sth 爬满、挤满：The floor crawled with ants 地板上爬满蚂蚁。派生：crawler n. 爬虫；网络爬虫，计算机语境常见。
collocations: traffic crawls 车流缓慢挪动
crawl with insects 爬满虫子
crawl along the road 沿路缓慢爬行
words.mnemonic: cr- 词族表爬缩：creep、crouch、crawl 一家 → 爬行

words.definition: n. 钻头，钻床；操练，训练；v. 钻孔；操练

examples.en: Workers drilled a hole in the wall to mount the air conditioner.
examples.zh: 工人们在墙上钻孔以安装空调。

examples.en: Regular vocabulary drills significantly improved the students' retention.
examples.zh: 定期词汇操练显著提高了学生的记忆效果。

words.usage: 本义钻孔：drill a hole in the wall 在墙上钻孔；引申反复操练：military drill 军事操练、spelling drills 拼写训练。教学场景的 drill 指强化练习。固定短语 fire drill 消防演习。派生：driller n. 钻探工；drilling n. 钻探，操练。
collocations: drill a hole 钻孔
fire drill 消防演习
grammar drills 语法操练
words.mnemonic: drill 锥子钻 → 钻孔；反复地钻 → 反复操练

words.definition: n. 缓冲物，缓冲器；（计算机）缓冲区；vt. 缓冲

examples.en: The forest belt acts as a buffer against flooding in the lowlands.
examples.zh: 防护林带起着缓冲作用，减轻了低地的洪水威胁。

examples.en: Central banks hold large reserves as a buffer against financial shocks.
examples.zh: 各国央行持有大量储备，以缓冲金融冲击。

words.usage: 科技与社会话题高频：buffer zone 缓冲区（军事、地理）、buffer state 缓冲国。计算机中指缓冲区，视频「缓冲」即 buffering。动词搭配 buffer the effects of sth 缓冲某事的影响。派生：buffering n. 缓冲处理，流媒体语境常见。
collocations: buffer zone 缓冲区
buffer state 缓冲国
act as a buffer 起缓冲作用
words.mnemonic: buff（软皮）+er → 垫块软皮防震 → 缓冲物

words.definition: n. 音频，声音；adj. 音频的，声音的

examples.en: The device can record high-quality audio and video simultaneously.
examples.zh: 这台设备能同时录制高质量的音频和视频。

examples.en: The poor audio quality of the lecture frustrated the online students.
examples.zh: 讲座音质太差，让上网课的学生们十分头疼。

words.usage: 多作定语：audio equipment 音频设备、audio books 有声书。词根 audi 表「听」，同族 audience 听众、audible 听得见的、auditorium 礼堂。技术语境常见 audio input and output 音频输入输出、streaming audio 流媒体音频。

synonyms.note: 声音，日常泛指一切声响

collocations: audio quality 音质
audio equipment 音频设备
audio signal 音频信号
words.mnemonic: audi（听）+o → 听的载体 → 音频；同根 audience 听众

words.definition: n. 摇篮；发源地；vt. 轻轻抱着，搂

examples.en: Mesopotamia is often regarded as the cradle of urban civilization.
examples.zh: 美索不达米亚常被视为城市文明的摇篮。

examples.en: The mother cradled the sleeping infant in her arms.
examples.zh: 母亲把熟睡的婴儿轻轻搂在怀里。

words.usage: 本义摇篮，考研常考引申义「发源地」：the cradle of civilization 文明的摇篮。动词指轻轻环抱：cradle the baby in one's arms 把婴儿搂在怀里。短语 from the cradle to the grave 从摇篮到坟墓，即一生一世，社会学话题常见。

confusables.note: 蜡烛，an 与 ra 之差

collocations: the cradle of civilization 文明的摇篮
cradle a baby 轻拥婴儿
from the cradle to the grave 一生一世
words.mnemonic: 摇篮孕育生命 → cradle 引申「文明的摇篮」即发源地
